newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B index ends down on correction.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B index ends down on correction.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index closed down on Tuesday on a correction following gains the day before and led by shares with poor results records, brokers said.
The B index fell 0.471 points or 0.72 percent to 65.401 on volume of 15.2 million shares worth $6.4 million against $8.8 million on Monday.
Brokers said selling in shares of companies with a record of poor results was heavy but shares of firms expected to post solid 1996 results were stable despite the fall in the index.
"Institutions have been adjusting their positions recently ahead of the 1996 results reporting season," one broker said.
"Generally speaking, today's fall is just a technical correction, which will help to support a rise in the index over the next few days," a second broker said.
Of 43 B shares, 42 traded with 21 down, eight flat and 13 up.
Shanghai Industrial Sewing Machine was the biggest loser on expectations of poor 1996 results, slipping $0.010 or 5.68 percent to $0.166 on volume of 41,900 shares.
China Textile Machinery followed, falling $0.008 or 5.0 percent to $0.152 on volume of 223,000 shares.
Shanghai Narcissus Electric Appliances was the most active issue on institutional selling, with 2.1 million shares changing hands. It ended flat at $0.184 amid speculative buying late in the session.
Shanghai A shares closed slightly lower on news China has moved to attract more retail investors by allowing individuals to open special state debt trading accounts, brokers said.
The A index fell 2.73 points or 0.27 percent to 997.96 on volume of 295.7 million worth 2.8 billion yuan.
The SSE 30 blue-chip index fell 5.37 points or 0.21 percent to 2577.71 points.
Shanxi Fenjiu was the biggest loser, falling 0.22 yuan or 2.95 percent to 7.23 yuan on turnover of 2.3 million shares.
